from icalendar import Calendar, Event
from datetime import datetime

cal = Calendar()

event = Event()

event.add("dtstart", datetime(2026, 9, 7, 11, 0, 0))

# Verify by reading back
with open("onboarding_equipment_status_review.ics", "rb") as f:
    verify_cal = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
    for component in verify_cal.walk():
        if component.name == "VEVENT":

            print(f"Start: {component.get('dtstart').dt}")

            print("Event created successfully!")
'''
